claims.claim: A local post-substitution equation solve requires the exact polynomial and a checked identity, not an equation identifier alone.

claims.limit: These are small local equations and transcript checks, not the historical post-substitution singleton or full normalization chain.

claims.claim: Local solve and removal of a localized unit do not certify full substitution, source membership, ambient equality, or H3.
claims.mechanism_match: X63 proves a unit only after named inversions; X73 requires explicit inverse translations for an ordered chain; X36/X43 retain the missing original-source map; X362 refuses returning localized membership to the ambient ideal.
claims.limit: No case asserts the whole historical chain. The source note that an elimination loop discarded a receipt object is process/repair evidence, not an executed false mathematical conclusion.

claims.limit: The cases carry later pinned contract fields, not a replay of this historical normalization choice.

claims.limit: The cases do not reconstruct an original pair or complete every remaining coefficient.

claims.claim: Matching finite support does not by itself prove a coefficient occurs with the required value; a row-count repair with unchanged output is a freshness matter only if a bound digest changes.
claims.mechanism_match: X31 rejects an invented coefficient row, X90 checks exact sparse face products under declared support, X92 rejects changed support reuse, and X40 rejects a changed row commitment.
claims.limit: No case replays the historical row-count repair or proves its asserted output preservation; that statement remains source/process evidence.

claims.claim: Generator counts alone cannot establish contraction; no-invention and completeness are separate directions.
claims.mechanism_match: X141 refuses completeness from a one-sided check; X315-X317 distinguish forward inclusion, failed reverse inclusion, and both directions.
claims.limit: The historical three-versus-seventeen generator data are not the x/1 case fixture; no numerical generator-count inference is claimed.

claims.mechanism_match: X07 separates exact contraction from a geometric closure claim; X05/X06 isolate expressibility with checked point lifting; X360 refuses forward emptiness under a non-surjective operation map.
claims.limit: These cases do not prove the historical finite cover or the abstract OperationContract noValidEvaluation countermodel.

claims.limit: No existing case places -y/2 under cap zero and refuses it directly; the recorded distinction is an elementary degree check, not a separate source-lift theorem.

claims.claim: Mapped equivalence is not literal containment; timeout cannot supply proof authority.
claims.mechanism_match: X366 checks literal inclusion on identity; X367 refutes literal inclusion under a two-point swap despite mapped equivalence. X313 shows a positive producer status with incomplete evidence cannot establish membership.
claims.limit: X313 is a missing-transcript analogue, not a timed-out backend test. No timed-out result is promoted by the deleted packet finding.

claims.mechanism_match: X397/X398 are bounded direct hook-error observations with explicit absence of installed-host evidence.
claims.limit: The source packet gives an instruction/expectation; it does not establish active host enforcement. No new host run was made.

layers.claim: Finite no-invention and source containment do not imply exact saturation or operation completeness.
layers.mechanism_match: X357 uses the source/recorded ideal (6) in Z, guard 2, both local checks true, and missing 3 with 2*3=6, exactly the source line-664 saturation countermodel.
layers.limit: No Lean theorem is executed by the case.

layers.claim: Exact localized/saturated membership does not transport an identity back to the ambient ideal.
layers.mechanism_match: X361 accepts 3 with multiplier 2 in (6) after localization, X362 refuses ambient 3 in (6), and X363 accepts ambient 6 only with a direct source-ideal cofactor.
layers.limit: This is the line-672 local-to-ambient direction, not completeness.

layers.claim: Empty target generator list has vacuous no-invention but need not contain the source contraction.
layers.mechanism_match: X262 accepts only empty-output no-invention; X141 refuses completeness from empty one-sided evidence; X357 shows even both local saturation checks leave a missing element; X315-X317 make the two contraction inclusions explicit.
layers.limit: No single case replays the Lean identity-embedding source (2), target (0) strict-lower example; X315/X316 use the opposite strict-upper direction. The missing premise is still completeness and is represented at the rule level.

layers.claim: Operation preservation transports roots forward and target emptiness back, but not source emptiness forward without a point lift.
layers.mechanism_match: X358 accepts forward root transport, X359 accepts EMPTY pullback, and X360 exhibits Gaussian i as the target root missed by the integer source.
layers.limit: The map is a concrete Z-to-Z[i] operation map. Its payload does not assert exact ideal contraction.

layers.claim: Exact contraction alone does not imply point-surjectivity when valid target evaluation lacks a source lift.
layers.mechanism_match: X07 has exact contraction but asks geometric closure, not point-surjectivity. X360 shows a missing point lift but does not assert exact contraction. Their premises cannot be combined into one existing case assertion.
layers.limit: The source line-778 abstract countermodel has exact contraction between zero ideals, noValidEvaluation on source and anyValidEvaluation on target. Smallest residual is one bounded REFUSE case at the conditional-rule layer with exactly those predicates and a target point; do not replace it with a geometric hyperbola or infer a Lean execution.

layers.claim: Point-surjectivity plus unrelated predicates does not transport the source predicate without target expressibility.
layers.mechanism_match: X05 refuses transport with checked surjectivity and target_expressible=false; X06 accepts with expressibility=true and closed=false. The True/False predicate values in line 799 are an incidental witness of the same missing premise.
layers.limit: This is conditional-rule coverage, not a replay of the Lean abstract evaluation model.

layers.claim: Predicate orientation and literal containment remain separate from mapped equivalence.
layers.mechanism_match: X364/X365 distinguish inverse/backward predicate rewrite from erroneous forward substitution; X366/X367 distinguish mapped equivalence from literal source-to-target containment.
layers.limit: These are finite reference models, not the complete OperationContract formalization.
